Hi team —

Quick precall notes from infra:
- Ports: for VPC-hosted installs we need TCP 443 (optional mTLS) for the control-plane API; if you are using our telemetry add-on there is an outbound TLS stream to our ingest endpoints (can be disabled for air-gapped installs).
- Air-gapped: installer is fully offline-capable; periodic license checks are optional and use a signed token exchange initiated from the customer side (no inbound connections).
- Network layout: recommend NAT for worker nodes, a dedicated management subnet for the control plane, and a bastion host for admin access. See attached topology (updated layer labels).
- Sizing: under your projected 400 concurrent sessions we recommend 2x A6000-equivalent GPUs across a small HA pair; we’ll run a quick perf sim on the call if you want.

Attachments: network_topology_v1.pdf (updated)

Thanks,
Marcus
